name: museum-opening-time-expanded
requirement: The candidate clearly gives the museum's opening time correctly according to the reference.

criteria.true: The candidate clearly states that the museum begins admitting visitors at 10:00 (10 AM), including an equivalent wording or a correct opening-hours range. Other irrelevant details do not change this.
criteria.false: The candidate gives a different time, omits or negates the opening time, attributes 10:00 only to another venue or event, asks a question without answering, or leaves the opening time unresolved.
